settings.label: Car name
settings.description: Name of the tuned car in the game's car list (display_name of the .moddedcarcontent file written by the build). The default is MY_ plus the stock car's name from the game, you can change it.

settings.label: Variant name
settings.description: Name of the car's preset/variant (text in en.cars.loc written by the build). Where exactly the game shows it is not confirmed.

settings.label: Displayed power
settings.description: Power value on the car's spec sheet (car_specs POWER of the mechanical preset). Display text only, it does not change the engine: use power_scale for that. The file stores the unit as HORSEPOWER_US.

settings.label: Displayed torque
settings.description: Torque value on the car's spec sheet (car_specs TORQUE of the mechanical preset). Display text only, it does not change the engine.

settings.label: Rev limiter
settings.description: Engine rev limiter (EngineData.limiter). The engine cuts power when it reaches this speed. nominal_rpm and engine_damage_rpm are separate settings and should normally be raised together with the limiter.

settings.label: Idle rpm
settings.description: Lowest engine speed (EngineData.minimum). Assumed to be the idle/stall speed, not confirmed in the game.

settings.label: Power scale
settings.description: Multiplies the torque value of every point of the engine power curve. 1.0 is stock, 1.056 is about +20 hp.

settings.label: Nominal rpm
settings.description: Nominal (peak) engine speed reference of the engine (EngineData.nominal_rpm). The stock value equals the rev limiter. What the game uses it for is not confirmed.

settings.label: Engine damage rpm
settings.description: Engine speed above which the engine takes damage (EngineData.damage.rpmDamageThreshold). Raise it together with the rev limiter, otherwise running at the new limiter damages the engine.

settings.label: Limiter cut frequency
settings.description: Frequency of the rev limiter cut (EngineData.limiterCycles). Assumed to set how quickly the limiter cuts and restores power at the limit, not confirmed.

settings.label: Engine inertia
settings.description: Rotational inertia of the engine (EngineData.inertia). Assumed: a higher value makes the engine speed rise and fall more slowly, not confirmed.

settings.label: Throttle lag up
settings.description: Throttle response lag when the throttle is opened (EngineData.throttle_lag_up). Scale and effect are not confirmed. The engine map also stores its own value, which this setting does not change.

settings.label: Throttle lag down
settings.description: Throttle response lag when the throttle is closed (EngineData.throttle_lag_dn). Scale and effect are not confirmed. The engine map also stores its own value, which this setting does not change.

settings.label: Coast scale
settings.description: Multiplies the value of every point of the engine coast (off-throttle) curve. From about 1000 rpm upwards the stock points are negative, so a higher factor means stronger engine braking there; the positive points at low rpm are scaled too. 1.0 is stock. Reading of the curve is assumed, not confirmed in the game.

settings.label: Final drive ratio
settings.description: Final drive ratio. A higher number shortens every gear: stronger acceleration, lower top speed.

settings.label: Gear 1 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 1st gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 2 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 2nd gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 3 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 3rd gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 4 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 4th gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 5 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 5th gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Gear 6 ratio
settings.description: Gear ratio of 6th gear. A higher number gives shorter gearing.

settings.label: Auto-shift up rpm
settings.description: Engine speed at which the automatic gearbox shifts up (GearBoxData.autoshifter.up). Raising it makes the automatic hold each gear longer; keep it below the rev limiter.

settings.label: Upshift time
settings.description: Duration of an upshift (GearBoxData.gear_up_time). Assumed to be milliseconds, not confirmed. A lower value gives faster shifts.

settings.label: Downshift time
settings.description: Duration of a downshift (GearBoxData.gear_dn_time). Assumed to be milliseconds, not confirmed. A lower value gives faster shifts.

settings.label: Auto cut-off time
settings.description: Time the engine power is cut during an automatic shift (GearBoxData.auto_cut_off_time). Assumed to be milliseconds, not confirmed. A lower value shortens the power cut.

settings.label: Diff power lock
settings.description: Default setup: how strongly the rear differential locks the rear wheels under throttle (0 = open, 1 = fully locked). Raising it makes both rear wheels turn together more, which helps keep the rear sliding on power.

settings.label: Diff coast lock
settings.description: Default setup: how strongly the rear differential locks the rear wheels when off throttle (0 = open, 1 = fully locked). Raising it keeps the rear locked together when you lift off the throttle.

settings.label: Diff preload
settings.description: Default setup: torque that always holds the differential locked, independent of throttle. Raising it locks the rear wheels together more even at low load.

settings.label: Diff power max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest value allowed for the differential power lock.

settings.label: Diff coast max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest value allowed for the differential coast lock.

settings.label: Diff preload max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest value allowed for the differential preload.

settings.label: Differential type
settings.description: Differential hardware model (DifferentialData.type). Spool is a fully locked rear axle, the drift classic. The stock file does not store this field, so it reads as the first choice, LSD. Not confirmed that the game applies it for this car.

settings.label: Steering ratio
settings.description: Default setup: steering wheel angle divided by front wheel angle. A lower number means quicker steering and less wheel turning for the same front wheel angle.

settings.label: Steering ratio min
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Lowest steering ratio allowed (quickest steering).

settings.label: Steering ratio max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest steering ratio allowed (slowest steering).

settings.label: Brake bias front
settings.description: Default setup: share of the braking force sent to the front axle. Lowering it moves braking to the rear, which makes the rear lock up and rotate sooner.

settings.label: Brake bias min
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Lowest front brake bias allowed. The stock file does not store this field, so it reads as 0.

settings.label: Brake bias max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest front brake bias allowed.

settings.label: Handbrake torque
settings.description: Braking torque of the handbrake (BrakesData.handBrakeTorque). Raising it locks the rear wheels harder when the handbrake is pulled, which helps start a slide.

settings.label: Total brake torque
settings.description: Total braking torque of the brake system (BrakesData.totalTorque). Raising it makes the brakes stronger.

settings.label: Steering lock
settings.description: Steering lock of the car (SteerControlsData.steer_lock, stored in the .car only). Assumed to be degrees of steering wheel rotation, not confirmed whether per side or lock to lock. Raising it allows more wheel rotation, and with it more front wheel angle.

settings.label: Car mass
settings.description: Physics mass of the car (GeneralCarData.totalMass, stored in the .car only). The displayed weight on the spec sheet is separate text. Raising it makes the car heavier to accelerate, brake and turn.

settings.label: Front anti-roll bar
settings.description: Default setup: stiffness of the front anti-roll bar. Stiffer means less body roll at the front and more understeer.

settings.label: Rear anti-roll bar
settings.description: Default setup: stiffness of the rear anti-roll bar. Stiffer means less body roll at the rear and more oversteer.

settings.label: Anti-roll bar min
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Lowest anti-roll bar stiffness allowed (front and rear).

settings.label: Anti-roll bar max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest anti-roll bar stiffness allowed (front and rear).

settings.label: Front spring rate
settings.description: Default setup: wheel rate of the front springs (both wheels). Stiffer means less body roll and dive at the front and more understeer.

settings.label: Rear spring rate
settings.description: Default setup: wheel rate of the rear springs (both wheels). Stiffer means less body roll and squat at the rear and more oversteer.

settings.label: Spring rate min
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Lowest wheel rate allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Spring rate max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest wheel rate allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Front damper slow bump
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel moves up slowly (body roll and pitch) on the front axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Front damper fast bump
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel is pushed up quickly (bumps and kerbs) on the front axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Front damper slow rebound
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel moves down slowly (body roll and pitch) on the front axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Front damper fast rebound
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel drops quickly (after bumps and kerbs) on the front axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Rear damper slow bump
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel moves up slowly (body roll and pitch) on the rear axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Rear damper fast bump
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel is pushed up quickly (bumps and kerbs) on the rear axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Rear damper slow rebound
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel moves down slowly (body roll and pitch) on the rear axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Rear damper fast rebound
settings.description: Default setup: damper force when the wheel drops quickly (after bumps and kerbs) on the rear axle (both wheels). Higher is firmer.

settings.label: Front camber
settings.description: Default setup: front wheel tilt (both wheels). More negative tilts the top of the wheel inward, which gives more grip in corners and less on straights.

settings.label: Rear camber
settings.description: Default setup: rear wheel tilt (both wheels). More negative tilts the top of the wheel inward, which gives more cornering grip and less straight-line grip at the rear.

settings.label: Front toe
settings.description: Default setup: front wheel toe angle (both wheels). Sign convention assumed: a negative value points the fronts slightly outward.

settings.label: Rear toe
settings.description: Default setup: rear wheel toe angle (both wheels). Sign convention assumed: a positive value points the rears slightly inward.

settings.label: Front tyre pressure
settings.description: Default setup: cold pressure of the front tyres. Raising it stiffens the tyre; the effect on grip depends on the tyre model.

settings.label: Rear tyre pressure
settings.description: Default setup: cold pressure of the rear tyres. Raising it stiffens the tyre; the effect on grip depends on the tyre model.

settings.label: Camber min
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Lowest wheel tilt allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Camber max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest wheel tilt allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Toe min
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Lowest toe angle allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Toe max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest toe angle allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Tyre pressure min
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Lowest tyre pressure allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Tyre pressure max
settings.description: Setup limit (range offered in the in-game setup screen, effect on the game not yet tested). Highest tyre pressure allowed (all four wheels).

settings.label: Starting fuel
settings.description: Default setup: fuel in the tank at the start. More fuel adds weight.
